Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
759 PM EDT Sat Oct 10 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SUNDAY EVENING...

.TONIGHT...E winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 to 3 ft.
Showers after midnight. 
.SUN...E winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. Showers
with a chance of tstms. 
.SUN NIGHT...SE winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt...becoming SW
after midnight. Waves 3 ft...subsiding to 1 ft after midnight.
Showers likely with a chance of tstms. 
.MON...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. Showers.
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft or less. 
.TUE NIGHT...SW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED...NW winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming N 10 to 15 kt after midnight.
Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.THU...N winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming E. Waves 1 to 2 ft.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
